Find out what [[Orphan Varny]] is up to beneath the [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]].

==Quest information==

===Objectives===
*Rendezvous with Althea.
*Help Althea find a way deeper into the tunnels.
*Reach the furthest depths of the Tunnels of the Forsaken.
*Defeat the manipulated grawl.
*Calm the [[God-touched Grawl]].
*Defeat [[Varny the Zealot]].
*Return to Ghost of Althea.

===Reward===
*1000 [[Experience]] (first time only)
*500 Experience (when repeated)
* [[Ghost of Althea]] joins your party (first time only)
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)

==Walkthrough==
If you are doing the quest for the first time and the first level of the dungeon contains high-level echoes, consider leaving and re-entering the dungeon after taking the quest to remove them.

Proceed through the dungeon in the same way as the previous quest, taking the [[Elemental Keystone]] from the bandits north of Althea and carrying it to the gate at the north end of the first level, and hugging the left side to navigate the second level of the dungeon. The Ghost of Althea will accompany you on the second and third levels if you are doing the quest for the first time. The way to the third level is just beyond where you previously found [[Duke Willgrove]], behind a rock wall which Althea demolishes.

On the third level of the dungeon, follow the winding path forward. Bear in mind that the enemy groups here are positioned close together, so you may want to pull them to avoid being overwhelmed. After the second bend, the path widens out, and you will need to turn to the south just before the second resurrection shrine. An [[Enraged Phantom]] appears when you approach the enemy group there, and must be killed to obtain the [[Boss Key]]. Again, pulling is advisable to separate the Phantom, a dangerous [[elementalist]] [[boss]], from the other ghosts guarding it. Once you have the key, continue along your original path towards the east, around the final bend to the [[Boss Lock]].

[[Varny the Zealot]] is waiting at the far end of the cavern, and will send three waves of Manipulated [[Grawl]] to attack you. These grawl have low levels but come in large numbers. Keeping your distance helps to engage more carefully and recover between waves. The second wave includes the [[God-touched Grawl]], a much stronger [[warrior]] boss, which becomes friendly when its health gets low, but does not attack the other grawl. Finally, Varny himself attacks with the last wave; he is a moderately powerful [[shutdown]] [[mesmer]], but poses little threat by himself, so consider pulling the grawl away from him and dispatching them first. Once the final wave is defeated, the [[Zealot's Chest]] will spawn, and you can complete the quest by speaking to the Ghost of Althea.

==Dialogue== 
===Initial dialogue=== 
;Ghost of Althea
:''"Last night I dreamt that an ancient pain was reawakened. The depths of the earth cried out for help. would you believe me if I told you I consider it a portent? I saw a tunnel, more than ancient, opening on another world.''

:''I would journey to the deepest depths of these tunnels, in search of a pathway beneath the Shiverpeaks, an escape route from this scorched wasteland. I would ask you to travel with me, '''to face whatever dangers the dark bowels of the world would hide in shadow''', and to secure passage for our brothers and sisters in exile toward the dream of a better life.''

:''If you would aid me, I will meet you near the old barracks.''''

===Reward dialogue===
;Ghost of Althea
:''"That grawl was the source of the pain I sensed. It is a pain I myself know well. Thanks to you, it has been freed.''

:''Perhaps we may say the same of Varny. I do not sense his spirit tethered to this plane, which indicates he has passed on. Like all those in this encampment, Varny was a victim of powers and ambitions beyond his control. Yet Varny's desire to obliterate the Charr is part of the same violent history that has left Ascalon in ruins. We did what we had to, and I will cast my prayers that Varny may find peace beyond this world.''

:''My dream of a hidden escape route from this war-torn kingdom was only that: wishful thinking. Yet as I look around at these survivors, I see that already new life is being whittled day by day."''
First time:
:''"As for myself? I am not yet ready to rest. '''I would join you, if you would have me''', and continue to fight for those who have been cast aside and forgotten."''
On repeating:
:''"As for myself? I am not yet ready to rest."''

==Notes==
* This quest is actually coded as two quests, one for the first time and one for repeated runs.
* Doing this quest in hard mode can yield two maximum requirement gold weapon drops with inscription slots from the [[Zealot's Chest|end chest]], but the quest rewards are still the same as normal mode.
* Remember to [[cover]] your important enchantment spells. The foes here can easily strip them. Cast enchantments of lower importance on top of them, and monitor them closely. It will give you precious time to recast when the foes strip them.
* When repeating the quest, it is possible to pull the various Manipulated Grawls in the boss room into a fight with the Echoes and Horsemen. It can thin their numbers significantly when finally facing the boss Varny, which is especially helpful in hard mode. This is not possible during a first run of the quest, because Echoes and Horsemen will not spawn yet.
